title: Loading Tn5 Enzyme with sci-protocol Oligonucleotides
author: Ryan Mulqueen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6zahf2e
materials: Anneal Oligo mixtures within a Thermocycler with the following reaction. 95 °C 00:05:00 Slow ramp down to 20 °C, at a rate of -2.5C/min 20 °C, hold This results in 16 micromolar (µM) annealed oligo species per reaction ( i7/ME' and i5/ME'). steps.title: Prepare Tn5 Dilution Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of 2.125X Tn5 Dilution buffer for protein dilution.

steps.title: Prepare Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Prepare Mosaic End reverse compliment (ME'), i7, and i5 oligonucleotides at 100 µM in Tris-HCl buffer (pH 8.0).

steps.title: Anneal dsDNA
steps.instruction: Prepare dsDNA through annealing for each i5 barcoded oligo (8 total) and each i7 barcoded oligo (12 total), adjusting volumes for a single 96-well plate loading.

steps.title: Load Oligos into 96-well Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 96-well plate according to the loading schema to achieve 10 µL of i5/ME' and i7/ME' Indexed Oligos at 8 µM per well.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of i5/ME' (16 µM) to each respective well in a row-wise fashion.
Add 5 µL of i7/ME' (16 µM) to each respective well in a column-wise fashion.

steps.title: Prepare Tn5 Protein
steps.instruction: Prepare Tn5 protein as described in the 'Generation and Purification of pTXB1.Tn5' protocol and adjust the NaCl concentration.

steps.title: Assemble Tn5/Oligo Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the salt-corrected Tn5 protein with the indexed oligos and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 12 µL of salt-corrected Tn5 to each well of the 96-well plate.

steps.title: Store Loaded Tn5
steps.instruction: Store the assembled Tn5/oligo mixture at -20 °C for no more than 8 months.
